relations.rationale: Both describe separate actions at the event but neither implies the other.
Nell unpacking signal boxes doesn't determine which layout is largest.
Unpacking signal boxes has no bearing on members lining up for sandwiches.
Nell unpacking signal boxes is consistent with and could plausibly lead into her later offering track suggestions, but doesn't strongly imply it.
Zeno bringing the first-aid kit is unrelated to attendance status of latecomers.
Bringing a first-aid kit doesn't relate to displaying a steam engine.
Zeno's first-aid kit has no connection to Nell's track spacing suggestions.
Checking the attendance sheet directly supports the claim about who has arrived and who is late.
Checking an attendance sheet has no bearing on class assignments.
Checking an attendance sheet has no bearing on class assignments.
Attendance status of latecomers is unrelated to which class Finn and Bo share.
Latecomers' arrival time is unrelated to when the refreshment table opens.
Latecomers arriving is a separate fact from visitors welcomed later in the day.
If Finn is in the same class as Bo, and Bo is not in the same class as Nell, this supports that Finn is also not in Nell's class, but doesn't directly support the Bo-Nell claim itself.
Being classmates has no bearing on comparing locomotives.
If Finn is in the same class as Bo, and Bo is not in the same class as Nell, then Finn is not in the same class as Nell, supporting this claim.
Class membership is unrelated to track spacing suggestions.
The claim about the largest layout being a mountain scene supports the further description of that same layout's location.
The layout's theme is unrelated to refreshment table timing.
The layout's placement near the door is unrelated to who organizes the event.
